# ASTB23: Stars, Galaxies & the Universe
### Astrophysics of Stars, Galaxies and the Universe
This page provides lecture notes, texts of home assignments and other material, such as the tutorial notes. **Please note that this is the only sure source of information on ASTB23.** Quercus is used for announcements and submission of assignments only.
:::
